Basic designs and main components are delivered to DSCS by Damen Shipyards Gorinchem. DSCS will provide the detailed engineering, and information for the supply chain and production. Facility and Maintenance department is one of Projects department of Damen Song Cam shipyard and is under supervision of Manager Projects.
